A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DreamText and contain readable methods, equations, experiments, references, and supplementary material. Inspection of all 14 pages in each version supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original quantitative comparisons, generated examples, loss and hyperparameter ablations, and the supplementary balanced-supervision experiment.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–4 and the main-text and supplementary visual evaluations.

M1.justification: Both versions use the same latent character masks, four loss components, alternating text-encoder/U-Net optimization, and approximately 25,000-step supervision warm-up. No algorithmic or architectural change is documented.

E1.justification: Both use SynthText, LAION-OCR, ICDAR13, and TextSeg, retaining scene text reconstruction, editing, and the same qualitative scenarios. The expanded main-text dataset description comes from v2's appendix.

E2.justification: Table 1 and the corresponding visual comparisons retain SD-Inpainting, DiffSTE, MOSTEL, TextDiffuser, AnyText, and UDiffText. Comparator membership in the supplementary comparisons is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The training budgets, model checkpoints, test sampling, reconstruction/editing procedures, and SeqAcc, FID, LPIPS, and mIoU metrics are unchanged. Training settings appearing in v3 Section 4.1.2 were already stated in v2's appendix.

E4.justification: Both retain the loss ablation, alpha/beta sensitivity study, attention-evolution analyses, and balanced-supervision ablation. Supplementary attention examples and qualitative cases are retained rather than newly added.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–4 match, including DreamText's FID of 12.13 and LPIPS of 0.0328 in Table 1. Figure 4 retains the same curves, and the qualitative outputs and reported findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives remain equivalent. v3 splits and numbers the cross-attention equations and explicitly omits the binary mask B only for notational simplicity; no mathematical argument or proof changes.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list retain the same claims about character fidelity, alternating optimization, joint encoder/generator training, balanced supervision, and superiority over existing methods. The shortened conclusion preserves these claims.

C2.justification: The explanations involving restricted character representations, misaligned attention, noisy masks, and excessive positional constraints are retained. The multiple-region limitation and privacy/societal discussion move into the main text without substantive revision.

D1.justification: The same hardware, checkpoints, training steps, batch size, learning rate, loss weights, inference time, and baseline instructions remain available. The relocated project-page link has the same destination.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 26 works and retain the same positioning relative to GAN-based and diffusion-based approaches. Numbered citations and expanded author names are bibliographic presentation changes.

P1.justification: v3 substantially reorganizes the main-text/appendix boundary, moving dataset descriptions, training configurations, limitations, and societal impacts into the main text. It introduces numbered section hierarchies and lettered appendices, updates the title and author block, shortens the conclusion, and repairs two missing section references.

P2.justification: All 13 figures and four tables are retained. Typography, caption styling, display sizes, and placement change; notably, Figure 4's plots have tighter whitespace cropping and Figure 9 moves and enlarges. The visual evidence itself is unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves navigation and accessibility by repairing the Method section's missing references to Section 4.3 and bringing existing training details and limitations into the main text. These are useful presentation gains, while the scientific evidence remains unchanged. Existing erroneous references to Table 6 and Equation 1 remain, limiting the editorial improvement.
